candidate.title: L7 network policy with terminatingTLS will not load the key `ca.crt` even if it is present in the secret
candidate.text: L7 network policy with terminatingTLS will not load the key `ca.crt` even if it is present in the secret. This prevents Envoy from incorrectly requiring client certificates from pods when using TLS termination. To retain old behaviour for bug compatibility, please set `--use-full-tls-context=true`.

evidence.excerpt:
* L7 network policy with terminatingTLS will not load the key `ca.crt` even if it is present in the
  secret. This prevents Envoy from incorrectly requiring client certificates from pods when using TLS
  termination. To retain old behaviour for bug compatibility, please set `--use-full-tls-context=true`.
